name: Button
description: The primary way to trigger an action — six variants, four sizes, a loading state, built on Base UI.

variant.description: Visual emphasis. One primary (default) per view; rest secondary/outline/ghost.

size.description: Control size. All keep a ≥44px touch target; icon is 44×44.

disabled.description: Non-interactive state; also drops the button out of the tab order.

loading.description: Shows a spinner and blocks interaction while an async action runs (sets aria-busy).

render.description: Replace the underlying element to compose Button with another (e.g. a link). Use instead of wrapping.

forbidden: Do not pass raw colors or arbitrary Tailwind values via className; use variant/size or a token.
Do not wrap Button in an <a> or <button>; use the `render` prop to change the element.
Do not shrink below the built-in size — every size keeps a ≥44px touch target on purpose.
Do not put an icon-only button in `size=default`; use `size=icon` and add an aria-label.
Do not leave a button in `loading` with no way out — always resolve the async state.

responsive.note: All sizes are ≥44px tall (mobile-first / PWA). Icon buttons are 44×44. On narrow viewports prefer full-width (className="w-full") over shrinking.
